questions.question: The average monthly salary of five friends is Rs. 62,000. Surinder, one of the five friends, got promotion and a hike in the salary. If the new average of their salaries is Rs. 64, 250, then how much is the increase in the monthly salary of Surinder?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average monthly salary of five friends is Rs. 62,000.

The new average of their salaries after the promotion is Rs. 64, 250

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of observation/Total number of observation

**Calculation:**

The total salary of five friends is

⇒ 62000 × 5 = Rs. 310000

The total salary after the promotion is

⇒ 64250 × 5 = Rs. 321250

So, the increment the person gets is

⇒ 321250 - 310000 = Rs.11250

**∴ The increment he got is Rs. 11250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Total change value = change in average × number of observations.

So, Increment in salary is

⇒ (64250 - 62000) × 5

⇒ 2250 × 5 = Rs. 11250

**∴ The increment he got is Rs. 11250.**

questions.question: A can do a work in 40 days and B can do the same work in 50 days. They worked together for 5 days and then B left the work. In how many days will A finish of remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do a work in 40 days and B can do the same work in 50 days

They worked together for 5 days and then B left the work

**Concept used:**

Efficiency ∝ 1/Time

**Calculation:**

Let A complete the remaining work in x days.

The efficiency of A is 1/40

And the efficiency of B is 1/50

So, the efficiency of A and B together is

⇒ (1/40) + (1/50)

⇒ (5 + 4)/200 = 9/200

A and B worked for 5 days, rest completed by A

⇒ (9/200) × 5 + (1/40) × x = 1

⇒ 9/40 + x/40 = 1

⇒ 9 + x = 40

⇒ x = 31 days

**∴ A will complete the rest of the work in 31 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: A person spends 22% of the monthly income on house rent, 40% of the income on house expenses and groceries, and 50% of the remaining on children's education and other heads. If the monthly savings are Rs. 3,800, then what is the expenditure (in Rs) on education and other heads?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A person spends 22% of the monthly income on house rent,

40% of the income on house expenses and groceries,

50% of the remaining on children's education and other heads 

And his monthly saving is Rs, 3,800

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Part value/Whole value) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the monthly income of the person be 100x

The amount he spends on rent

⇒ (22/100) × 100x = 22x

The amount he spends on house expenses and groceries

⇒ (40/100) × 100x = 40x

Remaining amount is

⇒ 100x - 22x - 40x = 38x

50% of the remaining on children's education and other heads 

⇒ (50/100) × 38x = 19x

The person saves 19x of his income

⇒ 19x = 3800

⇒ x = Rs. 200

The amount he spends on children's education and other heads 

⇒ 19 × 200 = Rs. 3800

**∴ The person spends Rs. 3800 on children's education and other heads****.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let total income be 100%

He spend 22% + 40% = 62%

⇒ Education = (50/100) × 38 = 19%

19% is savings of the person

⇒ savings = education = 19% = 3800

**∴ The person spends Rs. 3800 on children's education and other heads****.**

questions.question: A woman takes 3 hours 20 minutes in walking to a temple and riding back. She would have gained 2 hours by riding both ways. Half of the time she would take to walk both ways is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Woman takes 3 hours 20 minutes in two ways

**Concept used:**

Total time = T₁ + T₂

T₁ = Time taken by walking

T2 = Time taken by riding

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

She takes 2 hours less than actual if she rides both ways

Time for both ways = 3 hours 20 minutes – 2 hours

⇒ 1 hour 20 minutes

⇒ Time for one way = 40 minutes

Time for one way in walking = 3 hours 20 minutes – 40 minutes

⇒ 2 hours 40 minutes

**∴ Half of the time she would take to walk both ways is 2 hours 40 minutes**

questions.question: Two students A and B are paid a total of Rs. 4,400 as prize money. If A is paid 120 percent of the sum paid to B, how much is B paid (in Rs.) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B are paid Rs. 4400

A = 120% of B

**Concept used:**

Total = xA + yB

x and y are ratio

**Calculation:**

A = 120% of B

⇒ A = 6/5 of B

⇒ 5A = 6B

⇒ A/B = 6/5

⇒ A : B = 6 : 5

A + B = Rs. 4400

⇒ 11 units = 4400

⇒ 1 unit = 400

⇒ 5 units = 2000

⇒ B = Rs. 2000

**∴ B paid Rs. 2000**

questions.question: If the annual rate of simple interest increases from 9% to 13(1)/(2) %%, then the yearly interest increases by Rs. 3,690. What is the principal (in Rs.) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Interest increases = Rs. 3690

Interest rate increases 9% to 13(1)/(2) %%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Difference of Interest rate = 13.5% - 9% = 4.5%

⇒ 4.5% = 3690

⇒ 1% = 820

⇒ 100% = 82,000

∴ The principal is Rs. 82000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Formula used:**

I = (P × t × r)/100

I = interest

P = principal

t = time period

r = rate of interest

**Calculation:**

Let P be Rs. x

[(x × 13.5 × 1)/100] – [(x × 9 × 1)/100] = 3690

⇒ [(13.5x – 9x)/100] = 3690

⇒ (4.5x)/100 = 3690

⇒ x = (3690 × 100)/4.5

⇒ x = 82000

⇒ P = Rs. 82000

**∴ The principal is Rs. 82000**

questions.question: What is the least number which should be added to 3432 so that the sum is exactly divisible by 10, 5, 4 and 2?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Any number is divisible by both 5 and 10 only when the unit digit of a number is '0'.

Here, only 1 possibility by adding 8 to the number.

⇒ 3432 + 8 = 3440 

**∴ The required number is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Concept used:**

Any number that can be divided by a, b, c, and d is always a multiply a multiple of LCM(a, b, c, and d)

**Calculation:**

L. C. M of 10, 5, 4 and 2 = 20

On dividing 3432 by 20, the remainder is 12

Number to be added = 20 – 12 = 8

**∴ The required number is 8.**

questions.question: After allowing three successive discount of 15%, 20% and 18% on the marked price of an article, it is sold for Rs. 2,230.40. The marked price (in Rs) of the article is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price = Rs. 2,230.40

Successive discount = 15%, 20% and 18%

**Calculation:**

Let the marked price = Rs. x

According to the question:

Selling price = [x × (100 – 15)/100 × (100 – 20)/100 × (100 – 18)/100]

⇒ 2,230.40 = (x × 85/100 × 80/100 × 82/100)

⇒ 2,230.40 = (1394x/2500)

⇒ x = (223040 × 2500)/(1394 × 100) = 4000

**∴ The marked price (in Rs) of the article is Rs. 4000.**

questions.question:
A solid piece of iron in the form of a cuboid of dimensions 24.5 cm × 16.5 cm × 12 cm, is melted to form a solid sphere.

What is the radius (in cm) of the sphere? (Use π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of cuboid = 24.5 cm × 16.5 cm × 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of cuboid = lbh

Where, l = length, b = breadth, h = height

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³

**Concept used:**

The solid sphere is formed by melting the Cuboid, their volumes will be equal

**Calculation:**

According to question:

Volume of cuboid = Volume of sphere

⇒ lbh = (4/3)πr3

⇒ 24.5 × 16.5 × 12 = (4/3) × (22/7) × r³

⇒ r3 = (245 × 165 × 12 × 3 × 7)/(4 × 22 × 100)

⇒ r3 = (49 × 3 × 3 × 7)/(4 × 2)

⇒ r3 = (7³ × 3³ × 2³)/(2³ × 2³) 

⇒ r = (7 × 3)/2 = 10.5

**∴ The radius is 10.5 cm.**
